reason: The first two validation-only implementation checks showed a best COSA configuration at the new 20-step boundary. No supplementary test or withheld-cohort outcomes had been evaluated.
rule: After the fixed 16-candidate COSA grid, if its validation-selected active configuration uses 20 steps, additionally evaluate 50 steps at that selected starting rate. Perform this single boundary extension only, without subsequent test-driven tuning.
reporting: Report actual candidate count and any remaining boundary optimum. These additions are validation-only. This amendment is hashed before the full selection stage and all supplementary evaluation stages.
